name: smwmusic-salamander
title: Salamander 2 - Dear Blue
description:
Man it's been a while since I touched AddMusicK...! This is also my first submission on this site - I hope you enjoy this port!
Because I used a lot of samples, some stock SMW samples were omitted.
As is, it will work with all global songs and most sound effects, excluding anything using @7, @14, @21, @15, @17 and the Thunder sample. A sample group is included, and they use the "optimized" set of samples.
I imagine this kind of fast-paced song would be ideal in any sort of stage that demands high speed or warrants some kind of "cool" factor, maybe befitting of a final stage (the original song was used in the final stage of its game as well)
A super special thanks to HaruMKT for helping me out re-learn some of AMK as it's been... seven years? since I've last used it.
